hints.content: Let's consider each object and see if we can get a circle cross-section by slicing it in any way.

Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the cone parallel to its base:



[[☃ image 1]]

No matter at which height we slice the cone, the shape is always a circle.

options.alt: A cone with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is parallel to an base of the cone. The rectangle moves through the entire cone showing every possible cross-section. It cross-section includes a circle.

hints.content:
Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the cube parallel to one of its faces:



[[☃ image 1]]

We can also try to slice the cube diagonally:


[[☃ image 2]]

The cross-sections are never circles.

options.alt: A cube with a plane perpendicular to the cube's face passing through it and showing every cross-section as it vertical passes through.

A cube with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is parallel to an edge of the cube. The rectangle moves through the entire cube showing every possible cross-section. It cross-sections include a rectangle and a square.
